subject: MAP Kickoff: Multi-cloud marketplace listing (AWS + GCP) — roles, milestones, evaluation plan
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Elena Cruz <elena@cloudbridge.io>, Matt Johnson <matt.johnson@aws-partners.amazon.com>, Ravi Menon <ravi@gcp-partners.example.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP Kickoff: Multi-cloud marketplace listing (AWS + GCP) — roles, milestones, evaluation plan

Hi all,

Thanks for agreeing to kick off the mutual action plan for the CloudBridge listing across AWS and GCP. The goal for this thread is to align on owners, a concise milestone schedule for evaluation + listing, and any immediate blocking items (staging accounts, billing procurement, packaging assets).

Attached is a first-draft MAP and an evaluation checklist (attachments). Highlights I want us to confirm today:
- Who is owner for packaging (marketplace asset creation) per cloud.
- Staging/test accounts and expected dates for QA windows.
- Evaluation criteria and success metrics (performance, cost, SLOs).
- Procurement path + PoC pricing window and estimated close date.

Proposed high-level milestones (subject to your input):
1) Week of Oct 11 — finalize listing asset spec + legal checklist
2) Oct 18–29 — evaluation window with selected customers (2 weeks)
3) Nov 1–12 — marketplace packaging, internal QA
4) Nov 15 — go/no-go decision; if yes, schedule listing dates per cloud

Please review the attached MAP (multi-cloud_MAP_v0.3.xlsx) and the evaluation checklist. Elena / Matt / Ravi — could you confirm who at CloudBridge and within AWS/GCP will own the marketplace packaging on your side? Also call out any platform-specific blocking items (billing integrations, seller account approvals) we should add to the MAP.

Next internal sync: I propose a 30-min cadence on Wednesday 10/7 at 11:00 PT to walk the MAP and lock owners — if that works for the partner teams as well. If not, suggest another time.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Karthik
Director, Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachments: multi-cloud_MAP_v0.3.xlsx (spreadsheet), evaluation_criteria_checklist.md (markdown), redwood_marketplace_requirements.pdf (pdf)
From: Elena Cruz <elena@cloudbridge.io>

Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP Kickoff: Multi-cloud marketplace listing (AWS + GCP) — roles, milestones, evaluation plan

Thanks Karthik — excited to partner on this.

Quick answers from CloudBridge side:
- Owner (packaging + product assets): Elena Cruz (me) -> will be our point for listing assets and test accounts.
- Internal ops contact for billing/seller account approvals: Marcus Li (marcus@cloudbridge.io) — I'll loop him in once we lock schedule.
- Blockers: We need the seller account questionnaire filled for AWS (they require tax + legal info) and one GCP contact to provision a test project with billing enabled.

We can do Wed 10/7 11:00 PT for a 30-min kickoff — I added it to my calendar tentatively.

I've reviewed the MAP draft and added comments in the Drive doc (link). I'll send Marcus and our packaging checklist by EOD.

Best,
Elena
Partner Ops — CloudBridge

Thanks — a couple operational clarifications from the Redwood side:

1) Owners (Redwood):
   - Packaging & assets: Marissa Cole (me) — I'll coordinate the asset pack and screenshots for AWS + GCP.
   - Evaluation coordinator (customer outreach + logs): Alex Martinez will run the 2-week evaluation window and collect feedback.
   - Marketplace delivery (submission & follow-up): Sergio Alvarez will own submission tickets and track approval statuses.

2) Staging accounts: we can provision a Redwood test seller account for AWS by Oct 14 if the seller questionnaire is complete. For GCP we need the test project details from Ravi by Oct 12 to enable billing.

3) Evaluation criteria (from the checklist): success = average 95th percentile latency under target threshold, embedding throughput >= planned QPS, and no regressions on quality for top-10 prompts (we'll run our eval harness). Please review and flag anything missing.

I'll update the attached MAP with owners and the proposed RACI row. Karthik — can you confirm procurement path on the CloudBridge side for PoC credits (is an MSA amendment needed)?

Marissa
Sr. Product Manager, Marketplaces
Redwood Inference

Attachment: I added a new sheet in multi-cloud_MAP_v0.3.xlsx called "Owners_RACI"

- I'll spin up the eval harness and share a runbook by Tue 10/6 EOD with the test prompts and expected load patterns.
- Need two pilot customers for the week of Oct 18 — Karthik/Elena, can CloudBridge recommend 1–2 customers who can participate? We'll treat those as closed beta users (non-public).

If everyone is good, let's lock Wed 10/7 11:00 PT.
